workshop.title: 把开头、变化和结尾连起来
workshop.instruction: 比较真实细节与全文主线，找齐能撑住概括的线索；不要只盯最鲜明的一句话。

items.label: 用变化串起全文
items.prompt: Which clues trace the main story: problem, change, then result?
items.answer: A plant list becomes a guide visitors can follow.
items.reason: 起初没方向提示，后来加路线说明，试走时能完成路线；三处串起全文，不只是在介绍一棵树。
items.hint: 能覆盖全文的主题要照顾前后变化；一个真实细节不一定是主旨。
items.material:
THE GARDEN GUIDE
Our first guide to the school garden named the plants but gave no directions.
The first page listed a tall pine tree.
A new student stopped at each turning because she could not tell which path to take.
We added short directions before the plant descriptions and listed the stops in walking order.
In the next trial, she completed the route without asking where to go.
We learned that a guide should help visitors find their way, not just list plant names.

items.material:
THE PHOTO SHOW
The bright orange border was the first thing I noticed on the poster for our class photo show.
I thought the show would be about taking perfect pictures.
But beside each photo was a note about a mistake.
One picture showed a bird too blurry to identify.
The photographers explained what they would change next time.
I stayed to read every note and realised the show was about learning from failed attempts.

transfer.passage: At lunchtime, I saw a school worker carrying chairs alone. I moved my tray aside and carried two chairs. Then another student joined us. Soon several students were helping. Within a few minutes, the chairs were in place. No one had given a speech or asked us to help. One small action had started the shared work.
transfer.stem: Which title best covers the whole passage?

options.text: Choosing the Best Lunch Menu
One Small Act Brings Others In
A Speech That Changed the School

answer.display: One Small Act Brings Others In

explanation.strategy: 把起因、行动、后续变化和结尾放在一起，选能覆盖主线的标题。

steps.text: 从一个人搬椅子，到“我”加入，再到多名学生帮忙，主线是小行动带动共同劳动。
steps.reason: 椅子搬好是结果，结尾又点明小行动启动了合作。

steps.text: 午餐和餐盘只交代场景；文中还明确说没有人发表演说。
